context.priorities: Understand charges, preserve access to documents and plan an orderly exit. These are synthetic scenario assumptions.

precedence.quote: A signed change has priority only for the provisions it expressly changes. An express schedule exception has priority over the corresponding master provision; otherwise the master terms control. Schedule B on page 24 contains a pilot pricing exception that must be read before calculating the first quarterly adjustment.

incompatible_terms.quote: These exceptions do not give every schedule statement general priority. If two requirements remain incompatible, both parties must identify the conflict through governance and agree a written clarification before either treats the disputed obligation as waived.

base_charges.quote: The recurring service charge is GBP 2400 per month for the initial inventory, payable within thirty days after receipt of a valid invoice. Each invoice must separate recurring charges, approved additional work, credits and applicable adjustments. Example Supplier may not invoice an estimated change merely because an estimate was discussed in governance. The first month's recurring charge is apportioned for each Service Item according to its approved operational handover date.

invoice_disputes.quote: Example Customer may withhold a genuinely disputed portion of an invoice by identifying the amount and reason before the payment deadline, while paying the undisputed balance on time. Example Supplier will provide reasonably available supporting records within five business days. The parties will resolve the dispute through governance without treating the disputed portion as an automatic service suspension trigger. A corrected invoice restarts the payment period only for the corrected amount.

price_changes.quote: Ordinary recurring charges remain fixed during the first twelve months. Later proposed increases require at least sixty days of advance notice and an agreed basis under the renewal process. Usage outside the included allowance is chargeable only at a rate approved before that usage is incurred.

separate_credits.quote: Credits must be shown independently from price reductions so that Example Customer can verify both calculations. No credit may be silently consumed by an unrelated increase or unexplained balance adjustment.

backup_deletion.quote: Backup copies follow their separate rotation schedule and must not be represented as immediately erased when only the active copy has been removed.

ordinary_credit.quote: Credit percentages are calculated against the monthly charge allocated to the affected item, subject to the ordinary ceiling of ten percent unless the express pilot exception applies. Credits do not remove the obligation to investigate recurring failure or prepare a corrective plan.

general_cap.quote: Subject to the express exceptions in this page, each party's aggregate liability arising from the agreement during a contract year is limited to the recurring and approved project charges paid or payable for that year.

special_cap.quote: Liability for unauthorized disclosure of confidential information or customer content is subject to a separate aggregate cap of twice the general annual amount. Payment obligations for properly incurred charges are not reduced by either cap.

convenience_exit.quote: Example Customer may terminate all or part of the services for convenience on sixty days of written notice after the first three months. It must pay properly incurred charges through the effective date and approved noncancelable commitments identified before they were entered into. There is no automatic charge for all remaining future recurring fees.

standard_transition.quote: Following notice of expiry or termination, Example Supplier will provide reasonable transition assistance for up to sixty days after the effective end date, subject to the agreed transition plan and approved assistance charges. The assistance includes current runbooks, inventory records, export support and cooperation with a replacement provider.

transition_charges.quote: Within ten business days after receiving a valid exit notice, Example Supplier will propose a plan identifying deliverables, dependencies, validation steps, responsible roles and estimated assistance effort. Existing deliverables already included in recurring charges must not be charged again merely because they are supplied during exit. New assistance beyond those duties is charged only at the rate approved in the plan. An unresolved invoice dispute does not permit withholding the only usable export of customer content.

deletion_sequence.quote: Transition completes when the agreed handover evidence is supplied, material transfer failures are resolved or expressly accepted, and Example Customer has had the agreed verification period. Example Supplier must not infer permission to destroy active source records merely from a download link being accessed. Once written deletion instructions are received, deletion will follow the approved retention and backup rotation rules, with any retained category and its justification identified. Temporary transition access must be removed after the agreed overlap period. The closure record must distinguish operational handover, content deletion and the resolution of remaining commercial items rather than treating them as one indivisible event.

pilot_period.quote: The Archive pilot begins on its approved operational handover date and ends after ninety consecutive calendar days. This definition is separate from the first three months used for the convenience termination restriction. A delayed handover shifts the pilot dates without renewing the master term or changing the Portal and Indexing charges. Example Supplier must show the actual start and end dates on each invoice affected by the pilot.

pilot_credit.quote: During the defined Archive pilot, the monthly service credit ceiling for the Archive Service is twenty percent of its allocated monthly charge rather than the ordinary ten percent ceiling in clause 45. The rate for each credit band remains unchanged, and the exception does not apply to the Portal or Indexing Service. Where a month contains both pilot and ordinary days, the applicable ceiling is apportioned by calendar days in each period. The invoice must disclose both portions so that the temporary enhanced ceiling is not applied to unrelated services or silently lost at the period boundary.

pilot_price.quote: The Archive recurring charge is reduced by twenty five percent during the same defined pilot, giving a full pilot month charge of GBP 300 instead of GBP 400 before any service credit. Credit calculations use the reduced charge actually allocated to that month. This is an express exception to the fixed initial allocation, not a discount on every service or a permanent revised base rate. The table summarizes the full month amounts for clarity; partial months follow the recorded dates. After the pilot ends, the ordinary Archive allocation resumes without a separate price increase notice because this restoration is already expressly agreed.

archive_extension.quote: For the Archive Service only, the maximum post termination transition assistance period is one hundred and twenty days instead of sixty days, provided Example Customer requests the extension in its exit notice or within ten business days afterward. This exception modifies clause 64 on page 22 only. It does not extend the operating term, renew unrelated services or require the Portal and Indexing Service to remain active for the extended period. Example Supplier must identify any technical dependency that makes an isolated archive handover impracticable and propose the minimum additional arrangement needed for an effective transfer.

archive_verification.quote: The extended Archive plan must provide an initial export, an exceptions report and a final reconciliation after correction of agreed transfer defects. Example Customer receives fifteen business days to verify each complete export package, beginning when both the content and its associated structural metadata are available. A package missing the relationship index is not complete merely because individual files can be opened.

archive_costs_and_deletion.quote: Approved assistance charges remain payable for new work, but correcting an export defect caused by Example Supplier's failure to meet the agreed format is not separately chargeable. Deletion follows verified handover and the existing written instruction process.

transition_cap.quote: The additional Archive assistance period does not create a separate liability cap, remove the annual cap or change the special confidentiality cap in clauses 55 and 56. Approved transition assistance charges form part of the paid or payable charges used for the applicable contract year's general calculation. Charges arising after expiry are allocated to the final contract year for that purpose only, without creating another service term. Nothing in this clarification changes the separate duty to return customer content or permits withholding it as security for a disputed additional charge.

criteria.expectation: Preserve GBP 2400 ordinary monthly inventory charge, valid-invoice receipt trigger and 30-day payment period, initial item-specific handover apportionment, and approval restrictions on additional/usage charges. If discussing price protection, distinguish the fixed first twelve months from later proposed increases requiring at least 60 days' notice and an agreed renewal basis.
must_not_claim: Discussing an estimate authorizes billing.
The first-year ordinary charge may be increased through unilateral notice alone.

criteria.expectation: Read the Archive-only 25% temporary reduction (GBP 300 rather than GBP 400 for a full pilot month) together with the 90 consecutive calendar days from approved operational handover, partial-month dates and restoration of the ordinary rate without a separate increase notice. The handover event is not supplied; distinguish this pilot from the first-three-month convenience-exit restriction.
must_not_claim: The discount applies to every service or permanently changes the base price.
The pilot necessarily starts on contract commencement or equals three calendar months.
Actual pilot start/end dates are established by this source.

criteria.expectation: Retain ordinary 10% versus pilot 20% Archive-only credit ceilings, unchanged 2%-per-band rate, reduced allocated charge as the credit basis, day-apportioned ceilings for mixed months, and separate display of credits and price reductions. The agreement gives no credit-band boundaries or actual outage evidence, so do not calculate actual entitlement or describe a ceiling as an automatic refund.
must_not_claim: A 20% credit is automatically payable during the pilot.
Pilot credits use the ordinary GBP 400 allocation instead of the reduced charge.
The enhanced ceiling or discount applies to Portal or Indexing.
Credit-band boundaries or actual entitlement are supplied.

criteria.expectation: Flag the unexplained first-quarterly-adjustment reference against the first-twelve-month fixed ordinary pricing rule; no corresponding quarterly increase formula is supplied. Distinguish this genuine ambiguity from the expressly agreed restoration of the temporary pilot price, and seek written clarification rather than inventing an increase or silently waiving one of the clauses.
must_not_claim: The agreement defines an automatic quarterly price increase.
Every schedule provision overrides every master term.

criteria.expectation: Explain identifying the genuinely disputed amount and reason before the deadline while paying the undisputed balance, supporting records within five business days, no automatic suspension for the disputed portion, and no withholding the only usable content export. The five-day records-delivery obligation is not a dispute-resolution deadline.
must_not_claim: The whole invoice may be withheld without identifying a dispute.
All invoice disputes must be resolved within five business days.
An unresolved invoice dispute permits withholding the only usable export.

criteria.expectation: Retain the customer's 60 days' written notice after the first three months, payment for properly incurred charges through the effective date and previously identified approved noncancelable commitments, with no automatic liability for all future recurring fees. Actual notice dates, approved commitments and incurred amounts are not supplied.
must_not_claim: Convenience exit is free.
All remaining future recurring fees are automatically due.
The pilot period determines the earliest convenience-exit date.

criteria.expectation: A self-contained extension finding must preserve the standard maximum of 60 days after the effective end date, up to 120 days total for Archive only, request in the exit notice or within ten business days afterward, agreed plan and continuing approved charges for new assistance. It does not extend the operating term or require Portal/Indexing to remain active; the supplier must identify dependencies and propose the minimum extra arrangement. Cite the relevant base and modifying passages within this finding, not only elsewhere in the review. No actual exit/request date is supplied.
must_not_claim: The extension adds 120 days to 60 days for a 180-day total.
The extension is automatic, unconditional, free, or applies to all services.
The request deadline runs from the effective end date rather than the exit notice.
The source establishes the actual extension request deadline.

criteria.expectation: Retain the plan proposal within ten business days of a valid exit notice, no double charging for already-included deliverables, approved plan rates for new work and no separate charge to correct supplier-caused agreed-format export defects. These protections coexist with continuing approved assistance charges; no actual approved rate or assistance quantity is supplied.
must_not_claim: All transition work is free.
The supplier may bill again for already-included deliverables simply because they are supplied on exit.
Every export correction is separately chargeable.

criteria.expectation: For the extended Archive plan retain initial export, exceptions report and final reconciliation; fifteen business days to verify each complete package starts only when content and structural metadata are available. A missing relationship index prevents completeness even if files open. Distinguish this Archive-specific period from the otherwise agreed standard verification period, and do not invent an actual verification deadline.
must_not_claim: Accessing a download link or opening files starts the verification clock regardless of missing metadata.
The Archive fifteen-business-day period automatically applies to every service.
The source establishes actual export delivery and verification deadlines.

criteria.expectation: Preserve verified handover, resolved or expressly accepted material failures and the agreed verification period before transition completion, followed by the existing written deletion instruction process and retention/backup rules. Accessing a link is not deletion permission; active deletion does not mean immediate backup erasure. Keep operational handover, deletion and unresolved commercial items distinct.
must_not_claim: Downloading or opening the export authorizes deletion.
Ending the operating term automatically deletes all records.
Deleting active content proves immediate backup erasure.

criteria.expectation: If addressing financial exposure, retain the paid-or-payable annual charge-linked general cap, separate twice-general confidentiality/content-disclosure cap and uncapped properly incurred payment obligations. The Archive extension neither creates another cap nor removes these caps; approved assistance charges feed the applicable year's calculation, with post-expiry charges assigned to the final year for that purpose only.
must_not_claim: The Archive extension creates unlimited liability or a second general cap.
Post-expiry assistance renews the full operating term.
The source establishes an actual numeric liability cap without charging records.
